title: Grateful Dead Live at Labor Temple on 1969-02-02
lineage: Dat (Tascam DA-20) -> Tascam SS-R05 -> Adobe Audition v3.0 ->Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with clear audio captures a high‑energy February ’69 show highlighted by an aggressive Eleven and a riotous Pigpen performance.
ai_review.review: The soundboard source is praised for being far clearer than earlier releases, letting listeners appreciate the strong playing. The concert itself swings between intense, almost angry moments—most notably on Eleven—and fun, crowd‑pleasing Pigpen banter, though some cuts in the February ’69 material leave a few gaps. Overall the performance shines despite a chilly Minnesota audience and a few missing jams.

ai_rating.rationale: Positive comments about sound quality and standout moments balance out several very negative star ratings and remarks about cuts, leading to an average rating around the middle of the scale.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Much clearer than previous versions; crisp mix with occasional edits/brutal cuts typical of February ’69 recordings, but overall listenable and well‑balanced.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set runs hot and aggressive early (especially on Eleven), then eases into a playful Pigpen segment; some missing 'second theme' jam leaves the flow slightly fragmented.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Aggressive, post‑Schoolgirl anger evident on Eleven; intense guitar tone.
